portInfo.description: Bastia is Corsica’s northern commercial and ferry hub, also welcoming cruise ships under CCI Corse. The destination page groups Bastia with Ajaccio, Bonifacio, L’Île-Rousse, Porto-Vecchio and Propriano in a network attracting nearly half a million cruise visitors a year. Practical services include an information point in Terminal Nord open every day from the first to the last ship, plus PMR assistance.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
